summary: realpath resolves symlinks to return the real path, using the controller's filesystem because filters run on the controller.
questions: How do I resolve a symlink to its target path in Ansible?
Does realpath resolve paths on the managed host?

answer_card.title: realpath filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ path | realpath }}` follows symlinks and returns the real path. Filters run on the **controller**, so it resolves against the controller's filesystem, not the managed host.
